limitations: The result is a worst-case linear elliptic counterexample and does not assert failure on the motivating numerical benchmarks. Damping, regularization, trust regions, adaptive test selection, or well-conditioned test families can suppress the mechanism. Gram-inverse discrete-dual-norm weighting and general basis dependence of classical variational residual losses are prior work and are excluded from the novelty claim. The motivating preprint is recent and later revisions may alter the formulation.
provenance: Mathematical analysis of the general weak-test Gauss–Newton construction in arXiv:2609.20641v1, including a fixed-span unit-normalized counterexample, an exact frame-conditioning amplification law, and a tight-frame characterization of energy-consistent Euclidean measurement geometry.
record_title: Unit-normalized weak Gauss–Newton can amplify energy error without bound
